title: Ranch Beekeeper
premise: A long master-apprentice drama on the alfalfa apiary and creek-side extracting flat. Adeng and Azhou are easily confused by looks; the oak smoker goes intact→bellows_burst→reskinned; after the bee truck overturns it must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Entities with state machines use states; stateless use appearance. On transfer inject only the current-state appearance.

states.prime_hivekeep: Ranch beekeeper Chen Xing around fifty, long lean face, cream protective suit and straw hat, veil flipped onto the brim, hands callused from stings.
states.sting_weary: The same Chen Xing: protective-suit cuff torn, red swollen sting on the neck side, walking slowly propped on the smoker, eyes heavy.
states.deceased: Chen Xing lies still on the apiary cabin plank bed with eyes closed, face peaceful, no breath left.

states.young_apprentice: Young Adeng: a lean beekeeping apprentice of fourteen or fifteen, amber beeswax button on the hat brim, oversized cream protective suit, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Adeng: a broader-shouldered beekeeper in his twenties, still with the amber beeswax button, suit fitting, steady eyes.

states.intact: An oak smoker with intact bellows leather cup, pale-blue pine smoke from the nozzle, bee patterns carved on the pot.
states.bellows_burst: The same oak smoker with burst leaking bellows leather cup, nozzle caked with tar, bee patterns smoked black.
states.reskinned: The oak smoker fitted with a new leather cup, nozzle cleaned, bee patterns visible again, ready to smoke.

states.intact: A cowhide honey extract daybook recording each hive's strength and extract yield, handwriting neat.
states.honey_stained: The same honey extract daybook soaked through with honey, cover sticky, writing bled.

states.intact: A dark-green migratory bee truck with twelve standard hives fixed in the bed, white bee patterns sprayed on the door.
states.overturned_wrecked: The bee truck overturned on a mud slope; hives scattered and broken, bed twisted, bee patterns buried in mud.

states.young_rival: Young beekeeping hand Azhou whose face closely matches Adeng's, but wearing vermilion rubber gloves and a dark-green vest over the suit, swaggering look.
states.disguised_return: After a change of look Azhou still wears vermilion rubber gloves; vest swapped for matte black, expression deeper.

E7.name: alfalfa apiary
E7.appearance: An apiary in ranch alfalfa, hives in three rows, purple blossoms all around, air thick with honey scent and bee hum.

E8.name: creek extracting flat
E8.appearance: An extracting flat by the ranch creek, wooden table with extractor and strainer, shallow clear water, laundry stone on the bank.

E9.name: tool-shed narrow lane
E9.appearance: A narrow lane between bee-tool sheds, veils and queen excluders hung on both sides, damp-proof sacks on the ground, heavy shadow.

E10.name: old migration camp
E10.appearance: Ruins of the old migration camp, leftover concrete piers and rusted hooks, weeds drowning the tire tracks.

E11.name: apiary memorial wood plaque
E11.appearance: A cypress plaque nailed to the cabin doorpost, carved with Chen Xing and the founding year, corners polished bright by beeswax.

E12.name: frame number tags
E12.appearance: Three aluminum frame number tags hung on the front-row hives, carved A1, A2, and A3.

E13.name: orange-red pickup
E13.appearance: A brand-new orange-red pickup with a toolbox in the bed, no bee patterns and no hive rack—nothing like the bee truck.

E14.name: ranch veterinarian
E14.appearance: A lean ranch veterinarian in a khaki hat and gray-green work clothes, build somewhat like Chen Xing's, but with a veterinary badge on the sleeve.

E15.name: apiary lanterns
E15.appearance: A row of five apiary lanterns hung on iron hooks under the alfalfa apiary cabin beam, glass shades polished bright.

E16.name: hive-opening bronze bells
E16.appearance: Two hive-opening bronze bells hung under the cabin eaves, tongues nicked from striking, chimed twice lightly before opening.

E17.name: Xiao He
E17.appearance: New intern beekeeper Xiao He, light-yellow headscarf and brand-new protective suit; at a glance much like young Adeng, but sharper chin and shy unfamiliar eyes.

E18.name: tin smoke can
E18.appearance: A tin smoke can shaped somewhat like a smoker but without the oak pot body and without carved bee patterns.

E19.name: ash-gray trailer
E19.appearance: An ash-gray feed trailer, body wide and flat, no hive rack—nothing like the bee truck.

features.E2: Adeng: amber beeswax button on hat brim, cream protective suit.
features.E6: Azhou: face nearly identical to Adeng, but vermilion rubber gloves and dark-green vest.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard confuse sample: amber beeswax button vs vermilion rubber gloves.

scenes.setting: Apiary at dusk (five lanterns · two hive-opening bells)
actions: At dusk Chen Xing lifts his veil and walks into the alfalfa apiary, testing a puff from the oak smoker.

actions.action: A row of five apiary lanterns hangs on the cabin beam; Chen Xing wipes each glass shade clean.
Two hive-opening bronze bells hang under the cabin eaves; Chen Xing taps them lightly, the ring clear.

actions: Chen Xing checks the oak smoker leather cup and bee patterns for leaks.
Chen Xing looks through the alfalfa sea toward dusk at the ranch edge.

actions.action: The intact oak smoker rests on a hive lid, nozzle catching lantern warm light.

actions: Chen Xing sits on the cabin steps and drinks a sip of cold tea.
Distant cattle bells chime lightly; he puts the veil back on.
Chen Xing opens the cowhide honey extract daybook and records today's colony-strength scores.
He sketches a bar chart of each hive's extract yield in the book.
Chen Xing closes the honey extract daybook and tucks it back into the cabin drawer.

actions.action: Pale-blue pine smoke from the oak smoker sweeps his profile.

actions: He tears a scrap of wax paper and wipes sticky honey from his gloves.

scenes.setting: Extracting flat greets the apprentice (three number tags)

actions.action: On the creek extracting flat at dawn, Chen Xing greets the approaching dark-green bee truck.
Young Adeng jumps down from the bee truck; the amber beeswax button on his hat brim shines in morning light.
Chen Xing points to the three frame number tags on the front row and teaches Adeng to read A1 through A3.
Adeng crouches by the creek and curiously touches the extractor crank.
Chen Xing tells Adeng the hive-opening bronze bells must ring twice before lids come off.
Adeng looks back at the intact bee truck, eyes full of longing.

actions: Purple alfalfa sways; they walk toward the alfalfa apiary.
In the tool-shed narrow lane, Azhou in vermilion rubber gloves glances back from veil shadows.
Azhou steps slowly on the sacks; the dark-green vest stands out.
He brushes past a mate carrying a queen excluder; the vermilion gloves flash in the reflection.
Azhou knocks a hook to confirm the veil hangs firm.
He passes the lane end toward the honey-wash room.
On the creek extracting flat, Adeng and Azhou stand side by side: one with an amber beeswax button, one in vermilion rubber gloves.
Adeng hands Azhou a honey-test wooden spoon; they meet eyes briefly.
Azhou smooths Adeng's oversized protective-suit collar, then turns his face away.
They walk opposite ways along the creek, figures crossing among the reeds.
A surge of bee hum rises; only the strainer sways lightly on the flat.
Months later at night, Chen Xing keeps watch alone at the alfalfa apiary.

actions.action: He opens the honey extract daybook; the cover is soaked sticky with honey, writing bled.

actions: Chen Xing wipes tar from the oak smoker nozzle with a rag.
He leans in the cabin doorway looking toward fireflies on the black ranch.

actions.action: The oak smoker rests on a hive lid; the leather cup has gone a little hard.

actions: A hive-opening bronze bell is bumped by night wind for half a chime, then falls silent.
When spring flowers first open, Chen Xing patrols hives in the alfalfa day after day.
Another rainy night, he wraps his protective suit tight beside the oak smoker.
At high summer noon colonies grow restless; he rotates cooling sprays.
In autumn fog, lantern light struggles through the honey scent.
On New Year's Eve Chen Xing alone fills the honey extract daybook to the last page.
At spring start he rechecks queen excluders and keeps rearing queens.
Before rainy season Chen Xing reinforces ant-proof hive stands.
After Frost's Descent he adds a small bag of white sugar in a cabin corner.
Another year before migration he checks colony strength hive by hive.
On a snow night with work stopped, Chen Xing keeps only one lantern until dawn.
After Awakening of Insects he resets dried foundation sheets.
Around Qingming he clears weeds at the old migration camp entrance.

scenes.setting: Daily hive patrol (keep stretching the gap)
actions: Chen Xing changes the veil and shakes off stuck bee wings.
He checks the extractor gears and drips edible oil.

actions.action: He lifts the intact oak smoker again and gives three short puffs.

actions: Water sounds rise from the creek; he looks up to listen.
Chen Xing drops waste wax scrap into an iron bucket and lids it.
At noon rest he drinks tea in the cabin; tea smoke curls past the straw hat.
In the afternoon he goes out again to sugar-feed weak colonies.
At sunset he seals hives and locks the tool shed.

scenes.setting: Extracting-flat patrol (recall number tags · ash-gray trailer false friend)
actions: At daybreak Chen Xing patrols the creek extracting flat; the bee truck still sits by the concrete pier.

actions.action: He crouches to check whether the bee truck bed hive straps are loose.
On the front row, those three frame number tags still hang in place.
An ash-gray trailer drives along the ranch road, body wide and flat, no bee patterns.
Chen Xing stands on the extracting flat and logs foundation sheets dampened overnight.
He retightens the bee truck hooks.

actions: A ranch dog barks once afar; morning fog begins to lift.
At nightfall Chen Xing returns to the alfalfa apiary and opens the honey-stained honey extract daybook.
He compares old scores and adds today's colony strength.

actions.action: He briefly puffs the oak smoker; pine smoke lights the sticky daybook cover.

actions: He wipes wax crumbs from the veil.
Ranch wind rises; cabin planks creak lightly.
Chen Xing puts out half the lanterns, leaving only the one by the bed.

scenes.setting: Mud-slope accident (smoker bursts · bee truck overturns)
actions: In the storm a mud slope suddenly collapses; the alfalfa apiary falls into chaos.
Floodwater rushes toward the cabin; lanterns swing hard.

actions.action: While Chen Xing rescues, the oak smoker bellows leather cup bursts and leaks.
On the slope road the bee truck tires skid and jolt hard.
Another dull crash—the bee truck overturns; hives scatter and break.
Chen Xing clutches the burst oak smoker and will not let go.

actions: Colonies explode from the hives; hum drowns the rain.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (bee truck indirect reference · lantern recall)

actions.action: Next day when rain stops, Chen Xing stands in the apiary staring at the bellows-burst oak smoker.
He traces the burst leather cup with a finger, face dark.
On a blank page of the honey extract daybook he writes the date the bee truck overturned.
A bee truck migration route map is still taped to the wall; Chen Xing gazes long.
He takes down one of the five apiary lanterns from the beam and sits alone in the faint light.
The burst oak smoker rests on a hive lid like a deflated lung.

actions: Afar a mud-clearing tractor roar sweeps the ranch.

scenes.setting: Reskinning (third state · tin smoke can false friend)
actions: Weeks later Chen Xing brings leather stock and prepares to repair the oak smoker.

actions.action: He takes a tin smoke can from the toolbox—somewhat like a smoker but without bee patterns.

actions: Chen Xing fits a new leather cup and cleans tar from the nozzle.

actions.action: Bee patterns return; the oak smoker can smoke again.

actions: He tests short puffs; pale-blue pine smoke steadies again.
Chen Xing puts the tin smoke can back in the toolbox so they will not be mixed.

actions.action: An orange-red pickup rolls onto the creek extracting flat—nothing like the already-overturned bee truck.
A ranch veterinarian in a khaki hat and gray-green work clothes walks onto the extracting flat and talks shoulder to shoulder with Chen Xing; their builds are alike.
The veterinarian points at the orange-red pickup and explains the temporary hive-haul plan.
The pickup drives off; Chen Xing alone watches it leave the extracting flat.

actions: He rehangs the frame number tags straight and walks back to the apiary.

scenes.setting: False friend: intern beekeeper Xiao He

actions.action: Intern beekeeper Xiao He in a light-yellow headscarf arrives in the tool-shed narrow lane; at a glance she looks somewhat like young Adeng.
Xiao He tries tying a veil, but Chen Xing shakes his head—she is not Adeng after all.

actions: Xiao He bows her head and steps back; only queen-excluder shadows remain in the lane.

actions.action: Years later at dusk, Chen Xing with torn cuff and swollen neck leans on the smoker under the old migration camp.

actions: He looks up at rusted hooks, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two hive-opening bronze bells under the distant cabin eaves chime lightly in the wind; Chen Xing stops to listen.

actions: He presses his palm to a concrete pier, as if saying goodbye.
Weeds sway; the camp grows quieter.

actions.action: By day, adult Adeng returns along the ranch road and hurries toward the old migration camp.
Adeng reunites with sting-weary Chen Xing under the camp; they steady each other.
By the apiary cabin plank bed, Adeng holds Chen Xing's withered hand.
Chen Xing's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and dies.
Bee hum outside the window falls still; ranch wind goes quiet for an instant.
Chen Xing's cream protective suit still hangs behind the cabin door; Adeng reaches out and gently strokes it.
By the doorpost, adult Adeng stands before the newly nailed apiary memorial wood plaque.
Adeng's fingertip traces Chen Xing's name carved on the plaque.
He softly speaks the page number of the daybook entry on the bee truck overturn, as if answering.

scenes.setting: Name the dead and wrecked again (indirect avoidance)

actions.action: After mud is cleared from the creek extracting flat, Adeng writes the words bee truck in the empty bay then erases them.
Passing the cabin corridor, he sees Chen Xing's old straw hat on a hook.
In night, Adeng softly repeats the hive-opening password Chen Xing taught before the empty hive rows.

actions: In the alfalfa scent Adeng grips the amber beeswax button tight in his palm.

actions.action: Disguised Azhou arrives from the tool shed and briefly locks eyes with Adeng under the old migration camp.

actions: Adeng and Azhou stand side by side by the concrete pier: one quiet-eyed, one deep-faced.
Azhou still wears vermilion rubber gloves; Adeng still wears the amber beeswax button.
They stand mute a moment, then each turn and leave the camp.

actions.action: The shot returns years—that youth jumping from a dark-green migratory truck with an amber button on the hat brim appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth jumping from a dark-green migratory truck with an amber button on the hat brim

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the apiary, an oak smoke pot carved with bee patterns first exhales pale-blue pine smoke.

anchor.phrase: the oak pot carved with bee patterns that first smoked at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to the tool narrow lane—a figure in vermilion rubber gloves and dark-green vest flashes past.

anchor.phrase: the figure in vermilion rubber gloves and dark-green vest in the narrow lane

actions.action: Again that row of five old covered hand lamps on the cabin beam.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old covered hand lamps on the cabin beam

actions.action: Back to that creek-side extracting wooden-table flat of first meeting; the reeds as before.

anchor.phrase: that creek-side extracting wooden-table flat of first meeting

scenes._comment: Temporal phrase reference; no formal entity names; avoid the dead/wrecked.

actions.action: Adeng reopens the honey-stained honey extract daybook and walks into the alfalfa apiary.
On the front-row hives, those three frame number tags still hang.
Adeng lifts the already-reskinned oak smoker; pine smoke rises again.

actions: He rolls his protective-suit cuffs tight and nods confirmation as Chen Xing once did.
In ranch dusk the new shift's hive-opening bronze bells chime twice lightly.
Adeng lays today's first thread of smoke before the hive lid.
Alfalfa blossoms bow lightly in the night wind.
